claude.sample_unit: ICU encounters (26,045 development, 276 prospective silent-mode, 35,534 MIMIC-IV)

links.outcome: Prospective silent-mode performance on live EHR data versus retrospective performance
links.effect: Over a 1-month silent-mode deployment (276 encounters), AUC 0.908, sensitivity 0.632, specificity 0.849, PPV 0.235, above the 0.85 PCCP threshold, so no fine-tuning was needed.
links.quote: The final model achieved a sensitivity of 0.632, specificity of 0.849, and PPV of 0.235.

links.outcome: Model discrimination when applied to an external site dataset (MIMIC-IV)
links.effect: The UCSD-trained model's AUC dropped to 0.73 on MIMIC-IV, compared with 0.897 cross-validated and 0.908 prospective at UCSD.
links.quote: The final Vent.io model trained using UCSD data obtained an AUC of 0.73, lower than the minimum of 0.85 set by the PCCP, prompting a fine-tuning process.

links.outcome: External-site AUC before and after fine-tuning on local data
links.effect: Fine-tuning on MIMIC-IV data raised AUC from 0.73 to 0.873. Acceptable performance was reached using 25% or more of the local training data.
links.quote: The fine-tuned Vent.io model achieved an AUC of 0.873.

links.outcome: Whether a predefined AUC threshold in the PCCP triggers corrective retraining
links.effect: An AUC of 0.73, below the 0.85 PCCP threshold, triggered fine-tuning, which restored AUC to 0.873. UCSD prospective AUC stayed above the threshold, so no action was taken there.
links.quote: Vent.io had an AUC of 0.73 on the MIMIC-IV dataset, triggering model fine-tuning per the PCCP as the AUC was below the minimum of 0.85.

unlisted_practices: Conformal prediction module to flag out-of-distribution inputs and define conditions for use
Real-time gold-standard labeling via bulk FHIR to support rolling-window performance monitoring
Gradient-based per-prediction feature relevance scores for interpretability

openai.sample_unit: ICU encounters: 26 045 development, 276 prospective validation, and 35 534 external validation

links.outcome: Prospective versus retrospective predictive performance during silent deployment
links.effect: During 1-month silent deployment, AUC was 0.908 versus cross-validation median 0.897 (IQR: 0.892-0.904); prospective sensitivity was 0.632, specificity 0.849, and PPV 0.235.
links.quote: The Vent.io model had a median AUC of 0.897 (IQR: 0.892-0.904) with specificity of 0.81 (IQR: 0.812-0.841) and positive predictive value (PPV) of 0.174 (IQR: 0.148-0.176) at a fixed sensitivity of 0.6 during 10-fold cross validation and an AUC of 0.908, sensitivity of 0.632, specificity of 0.849, and PPV of 0.235 during prospective deployment.

links.outcome: External-site performance relative to development performance and the predefined acceptance threshold
links.effect: On MIMIC-IV, UCSD-trained Vent.io achieved AUC 0.73, below the PCCP minimum of 0.85 and UCSD cross-validation median AUC 0.897.
links.quote: The final Vent.io model trained using UCSD data obtained an AUC of 0.73, lower than the minimum of 0.85 set by the PCCP, prompting a fine-tuning process.

links.outcome: External-site discrimination after local model fine-tuning
links.effect: MIMIC-IV AUC improved from 0.73 to 0.873 after local fine-tuning; acceptable performance was achieved using 25% or more of the training data, exceeding the minimum AUC of 0.85.
links.quote: The fine-tuned Vent.io model achieved an AUC of 0.873.

links.effect: Model trained on UCSD data dropped to an AUC of 0.73 when validated on the MIMIC-IV dataset.
links.quote: The final Vent.io model trained using UCSD data obtained an AUC of 0.73, lower than the minimum of 0.85 set by the PCCP, prompting a fine-tuning process.

links.effect: Fine-tuning the model locally on MIMIC-IV data improved its AUC to 0.873.
links.quote: The fine-tuned Vent.io model achieved an AUC of 0.873.

links.effect: A predefined performance threshold of 0.85 successfully triggered model fine-tuning when the AUC dropped to 0.73.
links.quote: Vent.io had an AUC of 0.73 on the MIMIC-IV dataset, triggering model fine-tuning per the PCCP as the AUC was below the minimum of 0.85.

screen.practice: continuous monitoring and predetermined change control plan (PCCP) with triggered recalibration
screen.reason: The study deploys a clinical risk prediction model in silent mode on live EHR data and directly tests/evaluates a Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP) for continuous monitoring and triggered fine-tuning/recalibration when performance drops below a threshold.
